title: Settings persistence (save/load/corrupt-file defaults) has zero test coverage despite spec task claiming 'settings round-trip' pinned
evidence: grep -rn 'settings_load|settings_save' over all .odin/.sh returns only: './app/main.odin:276:	app.a11y = settings_load()' and './app/main.odin:779:	settings_save(app.a11y)' (plus the defs in app/settings.odin) — no @(test), no harness leg. Spec (diff, spec-7-3-accessibility-core.md) claims: '+- [x] Pin ACs as durable tests where the layers allow (palcheck legs, parity legs, settings round-trip)' and the AC: '+- Given a corrupt settings file, when the app launches, then defaults load, a note prints, and the app runs.'
detail: P1 acceptance criterion (user-ruled disk persistence) at 0% coverage: round-trip, corrupt-magic/checksum/out-of-range legs all untested; the checked task box overstates what shipped.
recommended_fix: Add app/settings_test.odin (@(test)): save→load equality via a temp-path override, plus corrupt legs (bad magic, bad checksum, out-of-range palette/scale) asserting DEFAULT_A11Y fallback.

title: Input parity never runs under any a11y mode — all 25 scenarios execute at palette-off/scale-1.00/reduced-off
evidence: grep -n 'ui_scale|reduced_motion|Palette_Mode|palette_apply_mode' harness/parity.odin → zero matches. Patch hunk (drive_parity): '+	view: rnd.View' '+	view.catalogs = cat // the render package reads the catalogs (tray chip count/rects)' — no mode/scale applied. Epic context added by this diff requires: '+- Full input parity (mouse/touch/controller) holds under every a11y mode; no input-dependent mechanics.'
detail: Slice requirement 'parity under every a11y mode' is mechanically 0% covered (default mode only ≈1 of 6 mode-states). ui_scale moves chip/row hit rects, so scaled hit-test parity is genuinely unexercised, not just theoretical.
recommended_fix: Parameterize drive_parity/run_input_parity with an a11y state (deutan/protan/tritan, reduced, scale 1.25/1.50) and run at least the settings-panel, draw, and tray scenarios per mode-state.

title: UI scaling: ×1.25 step has no golden/test, scaled hit-tests untested, and the 1152×648 min-window AC is not pinned
evidence: Only scale golden is ×1.50: patch demos/a11y_scale.dem line '+a11y scale 150'; demos/ contains no 125 variant (a11y_deutan/protan/reduced/scale/tritan). Harness renders fixed size: harness/main.odin:266 'rl.InitWindow(1280, 720, "pp-harness")'. Spec I/O matrix claims pinned: '+| Scale ×1.50 at min window 1152×648 | panel stepper | top band (health card, forecast, crisis banner), QoS panel, tray, caption strip never overlap | layout clamps, AC-pinned |'; AC: '+- Given scale ×1.50 at 1152×648, then no HUD overlap anywhere (top band, QoS, tray, captions, panel).'
detail: P1 at ~35%: ×1.00 byte-identity proven, ×1.50 golden-pinned, but ×1.25 never rendered in any test, no overlap check at the AC's min window (golden runs 1280×720), and chip/row hit-tests under scale are unexercised.
recommended_fix: Add a11y_scale125 demo+golden; add a harness render/overlap check at 1152×648 ×1.50; drive one parity scenario with ui_scale=1.50 so chip/row hit rects are tapped at scaled geometry.

title: Palcheck separation oracle has no negative leg — a synthetic too-close pair is never proven to FAIL
evidence: palcheck.odin lines 414-417: '		modes := []rnd.Palette_Mode{.Deutan, .Protan, .Tritan}' / '		for mode in modes {' / '			fails_a, min_d := a11y_separation_check(cat, &base, mode)' / '			check(fails_a == 0, fmt.aprintf("a11y separation (%s; min sim-dist %.1f)", rnd.palette_mode_name(mode), min_d), int(min_d * 100))' — only the positive expectation exists. Briefing lens-guard: 'verify it bites (a synthetic too-close pair must fail)'.
detail: P2: the never-color-alone gate's verifier is never shown to bite. A bug in cvd_simulate/cvd_dist (e.g., matrix typo) would pass silently — the only negative leg is base-water absence (a presence check, not separation).
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck self-test asserting a known-colliding pair fails: e.g., canon state_healthy vs state_critical under MACHADO_DEUTAN must report fails>0 (the collision the modes exist to fix).

title: Muted-audio captions contract ('muted ≠ silent') not pinned — spec I/O matrix said 'pin it'
evidence: grep -n 'mute' app/audio/audio_test.odin → no matches. audio.odin:93: '	muted:            bool,  // M toggles; captions stay live while muted'. Spec I/O matrix (diff): '+| Muted audio + alert | 7.2 seam | caption strip still captions (muted ≠ silent) | existing contract, pin it |'.
detail: P2: alert-kind captions (crisis + arrival) are well covered by existing audio tests, but the a11y-critical muted-still-captions invariant — the one leg the spec explicitly ordered pinned — has no test.
recommended_fix: Add an audio_test case: set a.muted = true, consume a CRISIS_TRIGGERED event, assert caption_live returns the crisis caption (and arrival analog).

title: New 'a11y' demo-verb parse-error legs are untested
evidence: Patch adds five error branches with no exercising test: '+					return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y palette (deutan|protan|tritan): %s", line)' and '+				if !okp || (pct != 100 && pct != 125 && pct != 150) {' / '+					return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y scale (100|125|150): %s", line)'. demos/ contains only valid a11y lines; no parse test exists.
detail: P3: the a11y verb's validation paths (bad palette name, scale 99, missing args) are dead in every gate — a regression to silent-accept would go unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add a tiny parse_demo check (harness self-test or parity-style CLI leg) feeding 'a11y palette bogus' and 'a11y scale 99', expecting parse errors.

title: No presence/content scans for the a11y_reduced and a11y_scale goldens — palcheck scans palette modes only
evidence: palcheck.odin:414 '		modes := []rnd.Palette_Mode{.Deutan, .Protan, .Tritan}' — the presence-scan loop loads goldens only for palette modes ('goldens/a11y_%s/65000ms.png'). PR body relies on vision for the others: '**Golden:** `a11y_reduced` pins the crisis moment static — banner + outline + ring all render (vision-verified).'
detail: P3: reduced/scale goldens are pinned by byte-identity alone; their semantic content (crisis banner present under reduced motion, larger chrome at ×1.50) is asserted only by one-time vision, unlike the palette goldens.
recommended_fix: Extend the palcheck loop (or add a small section) scanning a11y_reduced/65000ms.png for the banner/critical pixels and a11y_scale frames for scaled-chrome anchors.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Traced coverage per the 8 lens behaviours: (1) palettes+oracle 95% (separation/presence/restyle negative leg green; oracle-bite leg absent); (2) reduced-motion ~80% (golden regression pin; semantics vision-only); (3) scaling ~35% (×1.25 and 1152×648 AC untested); (4) captions ~85% (kinds covered by audio_test; muted leg unpinned); (5) settings panel parity 100%; (6) settings persistence 0%; (7) parity-under-a11y-modes ~17% (default state only); (8) a11y goldens 100% (mechanically verified per manifest + T2 gate).
detail: P0 = 100% (modes render/separate; sim byte-identity proven). P1 ≈ 33% (persistence 0%, parity-under-modes ~17%, scaling ~35%) — below the 80% floor. Overall ≈ 64% — below 80%. Gate FAIL.
recommended_fix: Land the settings round-trip/corrupt tests, run parity under each a11y mode-state, and cover ×1.25 + the 1152×648 overlap AC + scaled hit-tests; re-run tools/ci-local.sh palcheck+parity.
